title: Digit Frequency Score
summary: Given an integer n, calculate the score by summing the product of each distinct digit d and its frequency in n.
statement: Given an integer n, calculate the score by summing the product of each distinct digit d and its frequency in n. Return this score as an integer.
constraints: For each distinct decimal digit d, add d times its frequency in n.
Repeated occurrences contribute repeatedly and zero contributes nothing.
reference_solution:
def digit_frequency_score(n):
    return sum(int(digit) for digit in str(n))
hints: Expanding d*frequency(d) is the same as summing every digit occurrence.
Convert n to its decimal digits.
This counts repeats exactly as their frequency multipliers require.
editorial: This counts repeats exactly as their frequency multipliers require.

The two ones contribute two and zero contributes nothing.
